tools.name: G0_pending_delayed_group
tools.desc: Finds delayed orders (z-score >= 2.0 on any of the 4 real stages, computed against the whole portfolio). When $group_id is null, scans every case with no group_id yet (a fresh scan); when $group_id is set, re-scopes to that group's already-claimed cases (a resume). Returns each flagged (case_id, stage) row with its carrier/warehouse context. This is the group-formation tool -- run first, always.
tools.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {process: $process_type})
  WHERE o.order_date IS NOT NULL AND o.allocated_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN o.case_id AS case_id, 'ORDER_QUEUE' AS stage,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(o.order_date), datetime(o.allocated_at)).seconds) AS dwell_seconds
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {process: $process_type})
  WHERE s.pick_started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN s.case_id AS case_id, 'FULFILLMENT_DWELL' AS stage,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.pick_started_at), datetime(s.shipped_at)).seconds) AS dwell_seconds
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {process: $process_type})
  WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN s.case_id AS case_id, 'CARRIER_TRANSIT' AS stage,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.shipped_at), datetime(s.delivered_at)).seconds) AS dwell_seconds
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (inv:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:INVOICE {process: $process_type})
  MATCH (pay:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:PAYMENT {case_id: inv.case_id})
  WHERE inv.posted_at IS NOT NULL AND pay.cleared_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN inv.case_id AS case_id, 'BILLING_SETTLEMENT' AS stage,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(inv.posted_at), datetime(pay.cleared_at)).seconds) AS dwell_seconds
}
WITH stage, collect({case_id: case_id, dwell: dwell_seconds}) AS rows,
     avg(dwell_seconds) AS stage_mean, stDevP(dwell_seconds) AS stage_std
UNWIND rows AS r
WITH r.case_id AS case_id, stage, r.dwell AS dwell_seconds, stage_mean, stage_std
WHERE stage_std > 0 AND (dwell_seconds - stage_mean) / stage_std >= 2.0
MATCH (c:Entity:CASE_ROOT {case_id: case_id})
WHERE ($group_id IS NOT NULL AND c.group_id = $group_id)
   OR ($group_id IS NULL AND c.group_id IS NULL)
MATCH (o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {case_id: case_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (car:Entity:MASTER_DATA:CARRIER {entity_id: o.carrier_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (wh:Entity:MASTER_DATA:WAREHOUSE {entity_id: o.warehouse_id})
RETURN case_id, o.batch_id AS batch_id, stage,
       round(dwell_seconds / 3600, 2) AS observed_hours, round(stage_mean / 3600, 2) AS typical_hours,
       round((dwell_seconds - stage_mean) / 3600, 2) AS delta_hours,
       o.carrier_id AS primary_dim_id, car.name AS primary_dim_name, car.reliability_idx AS primary_dim_reliability_idx,
       o.warehouse_id AS secondary_dim_id, wh.name AS secondary_dim_name, wh.throughput_z AS secondary_dim_throughput_z
ORDER BY delta_hours DESC

tools.name: G1_group_stage_durations
tools.desc: For every case in $case_ids, all 4 real stage durations (ORDER_QUEUE, FULFILLMENT_DWELL, CARRIER_TRANSIT, BILLING_SETTLEMENT) in one query -- the group equivalent of the old per-case D1_stage_durations.
tools.cypher:
MATCH (o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {process: $process_type})
WHERE o.case_id IN $case_ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {case_id: o.case_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:INVOICE {case_id: o.case_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (pay:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:PAYMENT {case_id: o.case_id})
WITH o.case_id AS case_id,
  CASE WHEN o.order_date IS NOT NULL AND o.allocated_at IS NOT NULL
       THEN toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(o.order_date), datetime(o.allocated_at)).seconds) END AS order_queue_seconds,
  CASE WHEN s.pick_started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
       THEN toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.pick_started_at), datetime(s.shipped_at)).seconds) END AS fulfillment_seconds,
  CASE WHEN s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
       THEN toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.shipped_at), datetime(s.delivered_at)).seconds) END AS transit_seconds,
  CASE WHEN inv.posted_at IS NOT NULL AND pay.cleared_at IS NOT NULL
       THEN toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(inv.posted_at), datetime(pay.cleared_at)).seconds) END AS billing_seconds
UNWIND [
  {stage: 'ORDER_QUEUE', value: order_queue_seconds},
  {stage: 'FULFILLMENT_DWELL', value: fulfillment_seconds},
  {stage: 'CARRIER_TRANSIT', value: transit_seconds},
  {stage: 'BILLING_SETTLEMENT', value: billing_seconds}
] AS row
WITH case_id, row WHERE row.value IS NOT NULL
RETURN case_id, row.stage AS stage, round(row.value / 3600, 2) AS duration_hours
ORDER BY case_id, duration_hours DESC

tools.name: G2_group_event_timelines
tools.desc: Full chronological event timeline for every case in $case_ids, in one query -- the group equivalent of the old per-case D2_event_timeline.
tools.cypher:
MATCH (ev:EVENT {process: $process_type})
WHERE ev.case_id IN $case_ids
WITH ev ORDER BY ev.case_id, ev.event_time ASC
RETURN ev.case_id AS case_id, ev.event_type AS event_type, ev.event_time AS event_time

tools.name: G3_group_delay_contributors
tools.desc: OPTIONAL. Use first, when you need a quick rollup of which STAGE (ORDER_QUEUE/FULFILLMENT_DWELL/CARRIER_TRANSIT/BILLING_SETTLEMENT) dominates this group's delay before drilling into a specific carrier/warehouse dimension. Requires $case_ids. Returns stage, case_count, avg_hours, max_hours, ordered worst-first. Skip if G1's per-case rows already made the dominant stage obvious.
tools.cypher:
MATCH (o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {process: $process_type})
WHERE o.case_id IN $case_ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {case_id: o.case_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:INVOICE {case_id: o.case_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (pay:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:PAYMENT {case_id: o.case_id})
WITH
  CASE WHEN o.order_date IS NOT NULL AND o.allocated_at IS NOT NULL
       THEN toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(o.order_date), datetime(o.allocated_at)).seconds) END AS order_queue_seconds,
  CASE WHEN s.pick_started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
       THEN toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.pick_started_at), datetime(s.shipped_at)).seconds) END AS fulfillment_seconds,
  CASE WHEN s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
       THEN toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.shipped_at), datetime(s.delivered_at)).seconds) END AS transit_seconds,
  CASE WHEN inv.posted_at IS NOT NULL AND pay.cleared_at IS NOT NULL
       THEN toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(inv.posted_at), datetime(pay.cleared_at)).seconds) END AS billing_seconds
UNWIND [
  {stage: 'ORDER_QUEUE', value: order_queue_seconds},
  {stage: 'FULFILLMENT_DWELL', value: fulfillment_seconds},
  {stage: 'CARRIER_TRANSIT', value: transit_seconds},
  {stage: 'BILLING_SETTLEMENT', value: billing_seconds}
] AS row
WITH row.stage AS stage, row.value AS value WHERE value IS NOT NULL
RETURN stage, count(*) AS case_count, round(avg(value) / 3600, 2) AS avg_hours, round(max(value) / 3600, 2) AS max_hours
ORDER BY avg_hours DESC

tools.name: G4_carrier_reliability
tools.desc: OPTIONAL. Use when G0 or G1 shows CARRIER_TRANSIT delays. Compares this group's carriers by case count, avg transit hours, and each carrier's own reliability_idx master-data score. Requires $case_ids. Returns carrier_id, carrier_name, reliability_idx, case_count, avg_transit_hours. Do not use when delays are limited to ORDER_QUEUE or BILLING_SETTLEMENT.
tools.cypher:
MATCH (o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {process: $process_type})
WHERE o.case_id IN $case_ids
MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {case_id: o.case_id})
WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (car:Entity:MASTER_DATA:CARRIER {entity_id: o.carrier_id})
WITH o.carrier_id AS carrier_id, car.name AS carrier_name, car.reliability_idx AS reliability_idx,
     toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.shipped_at), datetime(s.delivered_at)).seconds) AS transit_seconds
RETURN carrier_id, carrier_name, reliability_idx, count(*) AS case_count,
       round(avg(transit_seconds) / 3600, 2) AS avg_transit_hours
ORDER BY avg_transit_hours DESC

tools.name: G5_group_warehouse_friction
tools.desc: OPTIONAL. Use when G0 or G1 shows FULFILLMENT_DWELL delays. Compares this group's warehouses by case count, avg fulfillment-dwell hours, and each warehouse's own throughput_z (stress indicator). Requires $case_ids. Returns warehouse_id, warehouse_name, throughput_z, case_count, avg_fulfillment_hours. Do not use when delays are limited to CARRIER_TRANSIT or BILLING_SETTLEMENT.
tools.cypher:
MATCH (o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {process: $process_type})
WHERE o.case_id IN $case_ids
MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {case_id: o.case_id})
WHERE s.pick_started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (wh:Entity:MASTER_DATA:WAREHOUSE {entity_id: o.warehouse_id})
WITH o.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, wh.name AS warehouse_name, wh.throughput_z AS throughput_z,
     toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.pick_started_at), datetime(s.shipped_at)).seconds) AS fulfillment_seconds
RETURN warehouse_id, warehouse_name, throughput_z, count(*) AS case_count,
       round(avg(fulfillment_seconds) / 3600, 2) AS avg_fulfillment_hours
ORDER BY avg_fulfillment_hours DESC

tools.name: G6_group_hotspot_by_customer_region
tools.desc: OPTIONAL. Use to see which region concentrates this group's delayed orders and how much revenue (order_value_usd) is at risk. Requires $case_ids. Returns region_code, case_count, revenue_at_risk_usd, sample_customers. Use alongside G4/G5 for a business-impact view -- it does not diagnose a stage, so pair it with a stage-level tool rather than using it alone.
tools.cypher:
MATCH (o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {process: $process_type})
WHERE o.case_id IN $case_ids
RETURN o.region_code AS region_code, count(*) AS case_count,
       round(sum(o.order_value_usd), 2) AS revenue_at_risk_usd,
       collect(DISTINCT o.customer_id)[0..5] AS sample_customers
ORDER BY case_count DESC

tools.name: G7_group_similar_cases_same_carrier
tools.desc: OPTIONAL. Use after G4 to check if the group's single dominant carrier is ALSO slow across the rest of the portfolio (outside this group) -- distinguishes a systemic carrier problem from a coincidence limited to this group. Requires $case_ids. Returns carrier_id, group_case_count, n_peer_cases, avg_peer_transit_hours, max_peer_transit_hours. Only meaningful once G4 has already identified one dominant carrier; skip if the group's carriers are evenly spread.
tools.cypher:
MATCH (o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {process: $process_type})
WHERE o.case_id IN $case_ids
WITH o.carrier_id AS carrier_id, count(*) AS group_case_count
ORDER BY group_case_count DESC LIMIT 1
MATCH (peer_o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {process: $process_type})
WHERE peer_o.carrier_id = carrier_id AND NOT peer_o.case_id IN $case_ids
MATCH (peer_s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {case_id: peer_o.case_id})
WHERE peer_s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND peer_s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
WITH carrier_id, group_case_count,
     toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(peer_s.shipped_at), datetime(peer_s.delivered_at)).seconds) / 3600 AS peer_transit_hours
RETURN carrier_id, group_case_count, count(*) AS n_peer_cases,
       round(avg(peer_transit_hours), 2) AS avg_peer_transit_hours,
       round(max(peer_transit_hours), 2) AS max_peer_transit_hours
